title: Margarita Made With Limeade
description:
A great, easy recipe for large batches of delicious frozen margaritas! No blenders or ice required for this recipe!
Mix all of the following ingredients in a plastic bag or tupperware, then place in freezer. Serve with a ladle once it
sets to a slushie consistency!
directions: Or, you can skip the water and make them with a blender by crushing the ice.
These can be served with limes and rim-salted glasses.
With an 8 oz limeade can and water, this is 88 oz, or enough for 11 8 oz drinks; with a 12 oz limeade can, 16.5
